title: user.recovery_restricted (v1)
description: A user account became recovery-restricted (MFA-010, USR-003): an active account signed in with a recovery code and no other strong factor. Sessions are not revoked; the session that used the recovery code is itself restricted to enrolling a new factor and ending sessions. Audit reason RECOVERY_CODE_USED. Subscribable (webhooks.EventTypes). org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

user_id.description: The user whose account state changed.

org_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
